spacex_q3_2026_nameplate_compute_definit.display: We calculate nameplate compute for a period as the number of GPUs installed in our data centers at the end of the period multiplied by their respective all-in power. Nameplate compute reflects installed capacity and does not represent actual power consumption or utilization. It does not include power we install and use for our supporting infrastructure such as cooling systems, power distribution losses, lighting, security systems, or facility-level overhead.
